title: rosa canina subvar. oenensis
intro: Rosa canina subvar. oenensis, commonly known as the wild rose of Sharon, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant, a type of rose species that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support cardiovascular health and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. oenensis are attributed to its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality, likely due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its health-promoting properties and potential therapeutic uses.
